narratives.paragraphText: EllisDon Corporation is a strategic-target BC general contractor with an active $1B+ healthcare design-build pipeline (Cowichan District Hospital, BC Cancer Centre Kamloops) plus major BC infrastructure work (Freedom Mobile Arch Vancouver mass timber canopy, TELUS Ocean Vancouver). On the defense side, EllisDon holds the Esquimalt JNCM design prime ($165M, $10.1M design phase Aug 2024) and the CFB Cold Lake FFCP FSF design-build. Subsidiaries: EllisDon Kinetic, EllisDon Infrastructure, EllisDon Infrastructure Healthcare. BC offices in Vancouver and Victoria. EllisDon is comparable in strategic importance to Graham Design Builders LP (canonical 8361) — both are go-to BC GCs for the next 5-10 years of healthcare + infrastructure pursuits.

Direct outreach to EllisDon Vancouver pre-construction RE: Esquimalt JNCM $165M structural sub-consultant slot (NOT publicly named, possibly open). Verify BC Cancer Centre Kamloops structural status (construction started July 2025, firm not disclosed). Pre-position with EllisDon for the 3 newly discovered BC defense MPIs (19 Wing Comox CMMA Hangar, 19 Wing Comox CFHA Housing Phase 2, CFB Esquimalt CFHA 120 Units — Ids 7161-7163 inserted via m109). Monitor Cowichan Phase 2-3 expansion procurement. Build sustained 12-month EllisDon relationship for compounding returns across BC healthcare + defense + infrastructure pipeline.
